title: Skills
subtitle: Your library of instructions. Anything here can be tried, edited and added to an agent when you want it used.

unavailable.subtitle: Skills service is not available or the index is rebuilding. Try again in a moment.

git.title: Git repositories
git.description: Add Git repositories to pull skills from. Skills will appear in the list after sync.
git.noRepos: No Git repos configured. Add one above.

empty.title: Skills are instructions an agent can follow
empty.text: Write one once, then add it to the agents that should follow it. A skill that nobody uses stays in the library.
empty.stepWrite: Write a skill, or import one from a .tar.gz file or a Git repository.
empty.stepTry: Try it: pick a context and see what it would add to a prompt.
empty.stepAdd: Add it to an agent when you want it used.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Skill
deleteDialog.message: Delete skill "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.

removeRepoDialog.title: Remove Git Repository
removeRepoDialog.message: Remove this Git repository? Skills from it will no longer be available.

pane.pick: Pick a skill to see what it says and who uses it.
pane.tokensExplain: In prompt mode an agent that uses this skill carries about {{count}} tokens in every message. This is an estimate: characters divided by four.
pane.filesFailed: The files could not be listed.
pane.filesNone: This skill has no scripts, references or assets.
